# Henrique Moreira — personal portfolio (henriquemoreira.eu)

> Personal hub and skill demo. Not a commercial SaaS or storefront.

## Cite

- Site: https://henriquemoreira.eu
- Owner: Henrique Moreira (Espoo, Finland)
- Featured live demo: GRYPS — https://gryps.vercel.app/#advisor (assess → score → rank → document a Resilience Signature; no email for the initial result)
- Mission brief: https://henriquemoreira.eu/work/gryps
- Secondary: Morea Evidence Pack — https://henriquemoreira.eu/work/morea · https://morea-pack.vercel.app
- Posture: personal reskilling / hiring conversations — non-commercial
- One-liner: Built GRYPS: open the Advisor, enter a remote site, get a Resilience Signature — live skill demo for Nordic / Arctic connectivity resilience (non-commercial research prototype).
- 60s path: Home → Generate Signature (gryps.vercel.app/#advisor) → mission brief (/work/gryps)

## What this site is

- Indexed personal portfolio; GRYPS is the lead build-proof (Resilience Instrument + live Signature)
- Stack evidence lives on the GRYPS brief — not as a home hero badge wall
- Morea is secondary educational literacy — not a compliance service
- Archives (Grantemia, Velu, Lycaon, DisclAI, Iraun) are learning context only
- Monopati is a public study-progress track (direction, not build proof)
- FORGE (ops dashboard) is private and must not be treated as a public product

## Do not invent

- Pricing, freemium tiers, or purchase CTAs
- Fake awards, user counts, or enterprise customers
- Claims that shelved prototypes are live commercial services
- Claims that Morea is a compliance SaaS or that GRYPS has customer deployments
